_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take; alarm = hard ceiling. Measured at the 1.0.0 re-baseline (2026-11-05; .claude/docs/build-times.md Astrolabe WHY 1). A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently.

forkBalance.why: Ported from Flow: slow-tests --forks N warns when the suite span exceeds sum/N x (1 + maxExcessRatio) + minExcessSeconds; an even deal leaves a few seconds of straggler (the last class of one fork), an idle or unbalanced fork leaves tens of percent

changes.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, median 6 s, max 23 s: one checkout + one git diff

server-tests.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 2m55s for 1,109 tests on 4 vCPU, single fork, at abed03f: just inside the target; a breach is the cue to try CI with two forks (the fork balancing is ported, build-times.md)

server.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, median 5m16s, range 3m18s-7m22s: compile + detekt + tests + Kover on 4 vCPU

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, last five median 55 s, max 1m16s: 50 s of it is the settings-plugin audit under --no-daemon

web.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, median 1m45s, range 1m02s-3m12s; 80 s with both caches hit, 192 s when a lockfile and config change misses the npm and ESLint caches (WHY 1)

e2e-static.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, median 47 s, range 19-70 s; npm ci alone took 42 s on a cache hit, 28 s for the whole job on another hit

images.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, last five median 3m21s, range 2m33s-3m41s: a plain docker compose build (2m45s) + the Trivy image scan (39 s)

k8s-static.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 14 master runs, median about 8 s, max 28 s: one checkout + kubeconform download + validating the manifests, raw and rendered

e2e.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 4 nightly runs, median 7m32s, range 6m03s-9m56s: images build + compose up + Playwright (113 tests at the time)

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 31 s in one run (6953b44): npm ci of the e2e workspace with the npm cache

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 31 s in one run (6953b44): install-deps (apt) with the browser cached; slower on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 2m40s in one run (6953b44), 2m45s in the images job at abed03f: a plain docker compose build of the app image, no layer cache

e2e/Start the stack.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 16 s in one run (6953b44): postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under up --wait

e2e/Run E2E.why: Measured 2026-11-05: 4m48s in one run (6953b44, 113 tests): the Playwright specs alone against a running stack

server-build.why: Measured 2026-11-05: Apple M5 Max, 93 runs, last five median 2m05s, previous five 2m29s, max 2m59s: cleanTest check :server:installDist -Pforks=1; since the fork-balancing port gates.sh runs -Pforks=2 by default (2m06s on 2026-11-07, build-times.md)

server-test.why: Measured 2026-11-05: one run, 2m40s for 1,109 tests: ./gradlew :server:test --rerun against one shared Postgres container

web-gates.why: Measured 2026-11-05: Apple M5 Max, 106 runs, last five median 22 s, max 41 s: lint:api + check:api + lint + knip + test:coverage + build

e2e-static.why: Measured 2026-11-05: Apple M5 Max, 43 runs, last five median 4.2 s, max 6.5 s: lint + knip + typecheck + check:scenarios and the small self-tests

e2e-playwright.why: Measured 2026-11-05: one run, 2m24s for 123 tests against the running compose stack
